[[Kolkata]], [[West Bengal]] 700053 | country = India | coordinates = {{Coord|22.5191|N|88.3234|E|display=inline, title}} | operator = [[Metro Railway, Kolkata]] | lines = {{rint|Kolkata|Purple}} | code = KMJH | platforms = 2 (2 [[side platforms]]) | tracks = 2 | connections = {{plainlist| * {{rint|kolkata|s}} [[Majerhat railway station|Majerhat]]: * {{nbsp|6}}{{rcb|Kolkata Suburban Railway|Sealdah South|croute}} * {{nbsp|6}}{{rcb|Kolkata Suburban Railway|Circular|croute}} }} | structure = Elevated | accessible = Yes {{access icon}} | status = Operational | opened = {{start date and age|df=yes|2024|03|06}} | electrified = | services = {{Adjstn|system=Kolkata Metro |line=Purple|right=Taratala |line2=Purple|type2=(Future service)|to-left2=Esplanade|left2=Mominpur|right2=Taratala}} | mapframe = yes | mapframe-marker = rail | mapframe-marker-color = #{{rail color|Kolkata Metro|Purple Line}} | mapframe-zoom = 14 | route_map = {{Kolkata Metro Purple Line}} | map_state = collapsed }} '''Majerhat metro station''' is an operational [[metro station]] on [[Purple Line (Kolkata Metro)|Purple Line]] of [[Kolkata Metro]]. It is the terminal station of the first phase 1 of this line and the first and only station built over an existing railway network, from [[Joka metro station and depot|Joka]] to Majerhat. The line was sanctioned in [[Railway budget of India|India's railway budget]] of 2010–11, but due to various hurdles, construction was delayed and missed multiple deadlines. The most notable reason for delays was the [[Majerhat Bridge Collapse|Majerhat Bridge collapse]] in 2018.{{Cite web|date=2021-02-07|title=Joka-Majerhat Metro Work Resumes and Earns Stability|url=https://www.gemscity.in/blog/joka-majehat-metro-update/|access-date=2021-11-16|website=Gems City|language=en}} == Location == Majerhat metro station is located in Alipore Mint Colony, Majerhat, [[Kolkata]], India. It is situated over the [[Majerhat railway station]] and parallel to the [[Majerhat Bridge|Majerhat flyover]]. [[Taratala metro station|Taratala]] is the preceding station towards [[Joka metro station and depot|Joka]] and [[Mominpur metro station|Mominpore]] is the following station towards Esplanade. == History == Since the {{convert|14.215|km|mi}} line was sanctioned by then [[Minister of Railways (India)|Railway Minister]] [[Mamata Banerjee]] in the [[Railway budget of India|Railway budget]] of 2010–11, it faced several problems which delayed the project. Originally the contracts of the elevated stretch of the line was awarded to Simplex Infrastructures in 2011, although construction couldn't proceed due to land acquisition problems. The contract for construction of the station was re-awarded to [[Gammon India]], in April 2012 by RVNL. In 2018, the adjacent rail over bridge (known as Majerhat Bridge) along the upcoming metro station [[2018 Kolkata bridge collapse|collapsed]], completely stalling the construction of the station as it ran into design, technical and legal challenges. Gammon pulled out of the project after the bridge collapsed.{{Cite web|date=2020-06-13|title=RVNL Invites Bids for Kolkata Metro Line-3's Mominpur Extension|url=https://themetrorailguy.com/2020/06/13/rvnl-invites-bids-for-kolkata-metro-line-3s-mominpur-extension/|access-date=2021-11-21|website=The Metro Rail Guy|language=en-US}} In August 2020, GPT Infraprojects won the bid for construction.{{Cite web|date=2020-08-18|title=GPT Infra Awarded Rs. 196.30cr Kolkata Metro Line-3 Contract|url=https://themetrorailguy.com/2020/08/18/gpt-infra-awarded-rs-196-30cr-kolkata-metro-line-3-contract/|access-date=2021-11-21|website=The Metro Rail Guy|language=en-US}} Work started in December 2020, with clearance from [[India Government Mint, Kolkata|India Government Mint]], [[Ministry of Finance (India)|Ministry of Finance]]; which initially didn't allow any elevated structure within a kilometre radius of the mint.{{Cite web |last1=Bandyopadhyay |first1=Krishnendu |date=January 5, 2021 |title=Kolkata: Girder-launch boost to Majerhat Metro station work |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kolkata/girder-launch-boost-to-majerhat-metro-stn-work/articleshow/80103746.cms |access-date=2021-11-21 |website=The Times of India |language=en}}{{Cite web|author=Ajanta Chakraborty|date=Dec 6, 2020|title=Kolkata: Majerhat bridge reopening paves way for metro station work|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kolkata/majerhat-bridge-reopening-paves-way-for-metro-stn-work/articleshow/79585797.cms|access-date=2021-11-21|website=The Times of India|language=en}} After lot of hardships and developmental work, the [[Taratala metro station|Taratala]]–Majerhat section of [[Purple Line (Kolkata Metro)|Purple Line]] was inaugurated on 6 March 2024.{{Cite news |date=2024-02-19 |title=Hope for ops start of three new Metro links in March first week |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kolkata/hope-for-ops-start-of-three-new-metro-links-in-march-first-week/articleshow/107806433.cms |access-date=2024-02-21 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} == Station layout == It is an elevated metro station with two [[side platform]]s. It is being implemented by [[Rail Vikas Nigam Limited]] (RVNL). The station is {{convert|180|m|ft|abbr=on}}180 m long with twelve [[Span (engineering)|spans]]. The platform and concourse area are {{convert|3050|m2|sqft|abbr=on}} and {{convert|3100|m2|sqft|abbr=on}} respectively. It is catered by five escalators, two elevators and five staircases and the whole station is held in between two massive concourse buildings on either side. It is the final station of the proposed phase 1 (Joka to Majerhat) of the [[Purple Line (Kolkata Metro)|Purple Line]].{{Cite web|title=Bangla News, Latest Bengali News, News in Bangla, বাংলা নিউজ – HT
